conventional wisdom: Conventional wisdom says breakfast is the most important meal of the day, but some new studies disagree.
傳統觀念認為早餐是一天中最重要的一餐，但一些新研究並不認同。
conventional weapons: The country has no nuclear bombs, so its army relies only on conventional weapons such as guns, tanks, and planes.
這個國家沒有核彈，所以軍隊只依靠傳統武器，例如槍枝、坦克和飛機。
a conventional approach: Instead of trying new ideas, the teacher took a conventional approach, teaching from the textbook and giving tests as usual.
這位老師沒有嘗試新點子，而是採取傳統的做法，照課本教學並一如往常地考試。
conventional medicine: Some patients try herbs and other treatments, but most doctors recommend conventional medicine that has been tested in hospitals.
有些病人嘗試草藥和其他療法，但大多數醫生推薦經過醫院測試的傳統西醫。
a cooperative effort: Cleaning up the beach was a cooperative effort, with students, parents, and local shop owners all working together.
清理海灘是一次合作的努力，學生、家長和當地店家一起出力。
be very cooperative: The witness was very cooperative and answered all of the police officer's questions patiently and in detail.
那位目擊者非常配合，耐心又詳細地回答了警察的所有問題。
a cooperative attitude: Thanks to her cooperative attitude, she gets along well with her teammates and is always willing to help others.
多虧了她合作的態度，她和隊友相處融洽，而且總是樂於幫助別人。
corporate culture: The company's corporate culture encourages workers to share ideas freely and to treat each other with respect.
這家公司的企業文化鼓勵員工自由分享想法並互相尊重。
corporate image: After the pollution scandal, the company spent millions on advertising to improve its corporate image.
汙染醜聞發生後，這家公司花了數百萬在廣告上來改善企業形象。
corporate responsibility: Protecting the environment is part of corporate responsibility, so large companies should try hard to reduce pollution.
保護環境是企業責任的一部分，所以大公司應該努力減少汙染。
the corporate world: After graduating from college, she entered the corporate world and started working for a large international company.
大學畢業後，她進入企業界，開始在一家大型跨國公司工作。
corporate tax: The government lowered the corporate tax so that more foreign companies would build factories in the country.
政府降低了公司稅，好讓更多外國公司在國內設廠。
a corrupt official: The corrupt official secretly took money from businessmen in exchange for favors and was later sent to prison.
那名貪官暗中收受商人的錢來換取好處，後來被關進監獄。
corrupt practices: Taking secret gifts from companies is one of the corrupt practices that the new law is designed to stop.
收受公司的秘密禮物是新法律旨在杜絕的腐敗行為之一。
a corrupt file: I couldn't open my homework because it was a corrupt file that had been damaged by a computer virus.
我打不開我的作業，因為那是一個被電腦病毒破壞而損毀的檔案。
a corrupt regime: The people finally rose up against the corrupt regime whose leaders had stolen much of the nation's wealth.
人民終於起來反抗那個腐敗的政權，其領導人盜取了國家大量的財富。
a costly mistake: Forgetting to save the file was a costly mistake, because I lost three hours of work and had to start again.
忘了存檔是個代價高昂的錯誤，因為我損失了三小時的工作，只好重新開始。
a costly delay: The broken machine caused a costly delay, and the factory lost a lot of money while waiting for repairs.
故障的機器造成損失重大的延誤，工廠在等待修理期間損失了很多錢。
prove costly: Ignoring that small leak in the roof may prove costly when you have to repair the whole ceiling later.
忽視屋頂那個小漏水，等到之後得修整片天花板時，結果可能付出很大代價。
run counter to: The results of the experiment run counter to what the scientists had expected, so they decided to test again.
實驗結果與科學家原本的預期相違背，所以他們決定再測試一次。
a counter-argument: In a good essay, you should present a counter-argument and then explain why your own opinion is still stronger.
在一篇好的文章中，你應該提出反駁的論點，然後解釋為什麼你自己的看法仍然更有力。
over the counter: You can buy this cold medicine over the counter at any drugstore without a note from your doctor.
你可以在任何藥局直接購買這種感冒藥（非處方），不需要醫生開的單子。
a courageous decision: Quitting her safe job to follow her dream of becoming an artist was a courageous decision that surprised her family.
辭去穩定的工作去追尋成為藝術家的夢想，是個讓家人驚訝的勇敢的決定。
courageous enough to speak out: Only a few students were courageous enough to speak out against the unfair rule in front of the principal.
只有少數學生有勇氣在校長面前直言反對那條不公平的規定。
a courteous reply: Even though the customer's email was rude, the clerk sent a courteous reply, thanking him politely for his comments.
雖然顧客的電子郵件很無禮，店員仍寄出客氣有禮的回覆，禮貌地感謝他的意見。
be courteous to customers: Hotel staff are trained to be courteous to customers, always smiling, greeting them warmly, and speaking politely.
飯店員工受過訓練，要對顧客禮貌周到，總是面帶微笑、熱情問候並禮貌地說話。
creative writing: In our creative writing class, students write their own poems and short stories instead of answering textbook questions.
在我們的創意寫作課上，學生創作自己的詩和短篇故事，而不是回答課本問題。
creative accounting: The company hid its huge losses through creative accounting, making the numbers look much better than they really were.
這家公司透過做假帳隱藏龐大的虧損，讓數字看起來比實際好得多。
a creative solution: Instead of buying new shelves, she found a creative solution and turned some old wooden boxes into bookcases.
她沒有買新架子，而是想到一個富創意的解決方案，把幾個舊木箱改造成書櫃。
the creative industries: The creative industries, such as film, music, and design, provide many jobs for talented young people.
創意產業，例如電影、音樂和設計，為有才華的年輕人提供許多工作機會。
